columns.name: has_thrombosis_2_ANA_S_IgM
columns.description: set to 1 if the patient has a degree of thrombosis level 2,  ANA pattern of only S, and a level of anti-Cardiolip in antibody (IgM) 20% higher than average ACL IgM among patients with thrombosis level 2 and ANA pattern 'S', otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: UA_index_in_latest_laboratory_examination
columns.description: the UA index in the patient's latest laboratory examination result

columns.name: num_laboratory_examinations_hematoclit_exceed_52
columns.description: The number of laboratory examinations where the patient’s hematocrit level exceeded 52, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: abnormal_white_blood_cell_count
columns.description: Set to 1 if the white blood cell count in the patient's latest laboratory examination is less than or equal to 3.5 or greater than or equal to 9, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: has_an_abnormal_level_of_glutamic_oxaloacetic_transaminase
columns.description: Set to 1 if the level of glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase in the patient's latest laboratory examination is greater than or equal to 60, otherwise, set to 0
